snippet.title: House Builder 2 OUT NOW on Xbox Series X|S! 🏠🔨 | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Grab your tools and get to work! 🏠

House Builder 2 is now available on Xbox Series X|S!

Build houses from scratch, tackle construction jobs, and experience the satisfaction of turning an empty plot into a finished home.

The Xbox release also includes the massive Overhaul Update, bringing major changes and improvements throughout the game.

🟢 Get House Builder 2 on Xbox:
https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9phzgfrwwt5f

Time to start building! 🔨

#HouseBuilder2 #XboxSeriesX #BuildingSimulator
